method: condition-cluster OOB bootstrap; refit (rate + weighted-median level) per replicate on in-bag conditions, scored on out-of-bag; F cached (data-independent), so the refit-in-loop is arithmetic (no PDE per replicate)
estimand_note: OOB held-out sets (~3-4 of 9 conditions) are LARGER than LOCO's single held-out condition, so this targets held-out error at a larger held-out fraction and its central value may exceed the LOCO point estimate (~6.5%); it repeats the fit and complements (does not replace) LOCO
coverage_note: no coverage study was run; a percentile interval over only 9 condition clusters is an exploratory uncertainty summary
note: Archived 2026-07-28 so the manuscript's 7.4 % out-of-bag point and its 95 % percentile interval can be checked against a recorded run instead of a prose sentence. Settings match what PAPER_A_P0-5_RESULTS.md reports (600 draws, seed 0). This is NOT a coverage-calibrated interval and is not described as one: repeating the fit removes one known source of optimism but does not establish nominal frequentist coverage, and with nine clusters it is an exploratory summary.
